stem.en: Kabir attacks. Pick his best card.

text.en: "The seed's switches flip when a signal arrives. So does a thermostat on a geyser: it senses heat and responds. You have not told me how the seed's cells sense anything, or what a signal is. Until you do, 'responds' is a word, not a mechanism."
"The boiled seed has the same tape, so the tape is not the difference."

feedback.en: True, and already in the Ledger from Book IV. This Book's line is not "has a tape" but "reads it with machines it built from it". The boiled seed's readers are tangled.

text.en: "A book plus a cook is alive, then."

feedback.en: A cook is a living thing. The seed is book and cook in one, and nothing outside it reads the tape.

image.alt: A boy playing his best card in a duel over a notebook page showing the flame-and-seed instructions ledger, an old cookbook open beside them.
